basic_info.description: Nestled on a tranquil street in San Francisco's Noe Valley neighborhood, just moments from the vibrant 24th Street shopping corridor, this stunning home features four bedrooms and three and a half baths. The kitchen and bathrooms have been meticulously remodeled, showcasing high-end fixtures and appliances. Enjoy sweeping views from various decks and outdoor living areas. The main level boasts a bright, open floor plan, offering captivating views of downtown and the serene rear yard from both the living and dining rooms. On the top floor, you'll find a spacious primary suite with access to an expansive roof deckideal for entertaining with panoramic views of downtown and Twin Peaks. The beautifully landscaped backyard serves as a private sanctuary, perfect for escaping the city's hustle and bustle. Additional features include a two-car side-by-side garage with internal access, equipped with a Tesla charger, and two additional parking spaces in the driveway.
